title: Air resistance magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates air resistance as 4 N using Newton's second law with upward acceleration from graph.

title: Return velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly determines return speed as 4√6 m/s using kinematics with downward acceleration and maximum height.

title: Average velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states average velocity is 0 m/s due to zero net displacement over round trip.

title: Upward acceleration analysis
description: Important: Extracts upward acceleration (12 m/s²) from v-t graph slope and applies Newton's second law.

title: Maximum height calculation
description: Important: Calculates maximum height (6 m) using area under v-t graph or kinematics with initial velocity and time.

title: Downward acceleration determination
description: Important: Computes downward acceleration (8 m/s²) using Newton's second law with air resistance opposing weight.

title: Sign/direction confusion
description: Pitfall: Treats velocity or acceleration signs incorrectly (e.g., ignoring vector nature in average velocity).

title: Air resistance assumption error
description: Pitfall: Assumes air resistance changes direction or magnitude incorrectly during motion.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (N, m/s, m/s²) throughout calculations without conversion errors.
